--- header_pre ---
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -7.5000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(4.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, 0.7000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float pulse, bellR, bellH; // breath phase; bell radius/height pulse in opposition
  static float ang, rad, topY; // frill scratch: segment angle, rim radius, rim height (tentacle() hangs off topY)
  static float sway; // rim/tentacle sway -- read both at top level (frill) and inside tentacle()
  static float segs = 26; // bell azimuth segments
  static float rings = 9; // bell latitude strips
  static float tentacles = 15; // @tune
  static float tentLen = 2.4; // @tune
  static float marineSnow = 110; // @tune

  // bell: latitude strips from crown to just past the equator (it curls
  // under). Everything except the alpha ripple depends only on the latitude
  // index i, so the whole ring -- geometry AND color -- is hoisted out of the
  // segment loop into function-scoped locals. u0/u1 are the two rows'
  // normalized latitudes, computed once instead of six times per vertex pair,
  // and ca/sa are the segment direction shared by both rows.
  bellStrips(segs, rings, r, h) {
    float phi0, phi1, radT, radB, yT, yB;
    float u0, u1, a, ca, sa;
    float rT, gT, aT, rB, gB, aB;
    for(i, 0, rings) {
      u0 = i/rings;
      u1 = (i + 1)/rings;
      phi0 = u0*PI*0.52;
      phi1 = u1*PI*0.52;
      radT = r*sin(phi0);
      yT = h*cos(phi0);
      radB = r*sin(phi1);
      yB = h*cos(phi1);
      rT = 0.10 + 0.30*u0;
      gT = 0.35 + 0.45*u0;
      aT = 0.05 + 0.20*u0*u0;
      rB = 0.10 + 0.30*u1;
      gB = 0.35 + 0.45*u1;
      aB = 0.05 + 0.20*u1*u1;
      glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
        for(j, 0, segs+1) {
          a = j*TAU/segs;
          ca = cos(a);
          sa = sin(a);
          glColor4f(rT, gT, 0.95, aT + 0.04*sin(a*6 - t*2));
          glVertex3f(radT*ca, yT, radT*sa);
          glColor4f(rB, gB, 0.95, aB + 0.04*sin(a*6 - t*2));
          glVertex3f(radB*ca, yB, radB*sa);
        }
      glEnd();
    }
  }

  // one tentacle: a swaying line strip; alpha fades toward the tip and the
  // pulse tugs the strand upward (the drop*drop term makes tips lag the bell)
  tentacle(angAt, attach, len, phase, amp, cr, cg, cb) {
    float ax, az, drop;
    ax = cos(angAt)*attach;
    az = sin(angAt)*attach;
    glBegin(GL_LINE_STRIP);
      for(s, 0, 14) {
        drop = s/13;
        sway = amp*(sin(t*1.4 + phase + drop*3.5) + 0.4*sin(t*2.3 + phase*1.7 + drop*6))*drop;
        glColor4f(cr, cg, cb, 0.04 + 0.40*(1 - drop)*(1 - drop));
        glVertex3f(ax*(1 + 0.2*drop) + sway, topY - drop*len + 0.15*pulse*drop*drop, az*(1 + 0.2*drop) + sway*0.55);
      }
    glEnd();
  }


  // Everything glows: additive blend with depth WRITES off (reads stay on).
  // glDepthMask(GL_FALSE) is the classic translucency trick - without it the
  // bell's far side would z-fight its near side and the tentacles would
  // punch holes through the bell.
  glClearColor(0.015, 0.03, 0.07, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glEnable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  glEnable(GL_POINT_SMOOTH);
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
  pulse = sin(t*1.6);
  bellR = 1.5*(1 + 0.10*pulse);
  bellH = 1.1*(1 - 0.14*pulse);

  // marine snow: slow upward drift, wrapped with rem() so the field loops
  glPointSize(7);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    for(p, 0, marineSnow) {
      glColor4f(0.55, 0.75, 0.95, 0.08 + 0.22*rand(p, 4));
      // rise speed 0.15..0.5 per mote; rem() wraps y into [-3.2, 3.2]
      glVertex3f(4.5*rand2(p, 0) + 0.2*sin(t*0.4 + p), rem(3.2*rand2(p, 1) + t*(0.15 + 0.35*rand(p, 3)), 6.4), 4.5*rand2(p, 2));
    }
  glEnd();

  // gentle bob + tilt for the whole animal
  glTranslatef(0.2*sin(t*0.4), 0.18*sin(t*0.5), 0);
  glRotatef(8*sin(t*0.23), 0, 0, 1);
  // segs/rings shadow the globals of the same name on purpose: the func takes
  // what it needs as arguments, so it reads without looking outward.
  bellStrips(segs, rings, bellR, bellH);

  // scalloped frill hanging off the rim
  rad = bellR*sin(PI*0.52);
  topY = bellH*cos(PI*0.52);
  glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
    for(j, 0, segs+1) {
      ang = j*TAU/segs;
      sway = -0.18 - 0.10*pulse + 0.10*sin(ang*9 + t*2.6);
      glColor4f(0.45, 0.85, 1, 0.3);
      glVertex3f(rad*cos(ang), topY, rad*sin(ang));
      glColor4f(0.45, 0.85, 1, 0.03);
      glVertex3f(rad*1.04*cos(ang), topY + sway, rad*1.04*sin(ang));
    }
  glEnd();
  glLineWidth(1.6);
  for(k, 0, tentacles) {
    tentacle(k*TAU/tentacles + 0.2*rand2(k, 1), bellR*0.85, tentLen*(0.75 + 0.5*rand(k, 2)), rand(k, 3)*TAU, 0.3, 0.35, 0.75, 1.0);
  }
  // four thicker oral arms under the crown
  glLineWidth(3.2);
  for(k, 0, 4) {
    tentacle(k*TAU/4 + 0.4, bellR*0.3, tentLen*1.2, k*1.7, 0.55, 1.0, 0.45, 0.75);
  }
  glLineWidth(1);

  // bioluminescent core: two stacked soft points
  glPointSize(30);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glColor4f(1, 0.55, 0.75, 0.3);
    glVertex3f(0, bellH*0.3, 0);
  glEnd();
  glPointSize(13);
  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    glColor4f(1, 0.8, 0.9, 0.55);
    glVertex3f(0, bellH*0.32, 0);
  glEnd();

  // leave shared GL state the way we found it
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);
